medium: dark-ground data graphics: a deep-blue US map on near-black with magenta or blue districts lit up, crimson district shapes with a red-to-blue gradient bar, grids of year squares; screenshots of charts and articles; black ladder diagrams on paper; the creator at a desk by a stained-glass window
avoid: cartoon, hand-drawn sketch, bright or white backgrounds on map graphics, 3D render, text baked into the image
note: Captions sit at 0.69-0.83 of the frame, so stills are cropped to the top 66%. The party-cartoon bits use cut-out photos of real faces - never generated. Caption: white serif, centred low, on a soft dark box.

looks.label: Dark US map with districts lit
looks.when: the default for anything with a where - a state, a district, a region, who lives where, which places matter.
looks.prompt: A data graphic on a near-black ground: the United States as a flat deep-blue shape with thin lighter district lines, a few districts or states lit in magenta or royal blue, or a single district shape in crimson with a horizontal bar fading from blue to red beneath it; small, precise, lots of dark space around; any labels as tiny illegible serif marks.

looks.label: Grid of years in one colour
looks.when: a streak - the same result over and over, decades of one outcome, an unbroken run.
looks.prompt: A data graphic on a near-black ground: a tight grid of small squares all in one colour - crimson or royal blue - each carrying a tiny illegible number, a small serif heading above, and a small boxed inset of a district shape to one side; dark space around.

looks.label: Chart or article screenshot
looks.when: a source - a poll, a chart, a headline, an article - shown as the page itself, sometimes with a red circle or arrow drawn on it.
looks.prompt: A screenshot filling the frame: a polling line chart on a pale green ground with two coloured lines and a small logo, or a newspaper article page with a bold serif headline as grey illegible lines and body text below, a hand-drawn red circle or arrow marking one detail. No readable words, no real publication names.

looks.label: Black ladder diagram on paper
looks.when: a scale, a ranking, an escalation - steps from small to total, drawn as rungs.
looks.prompt: A simple diagram on off-white paper with soft window shadow: a thick black ladder standing upright, its rungs as steps of a scale, tiny flags or map shapes placed beside the rungs, a thin red arrow along one side; labels as illegible marks; nothing else on the page.

looks.label: Old printed page
looks.when: an old text is quoted - a founder, a pamphlet, a law from centuries ago.
looks.prompt: A close photograph of a page from an eighteenth-century book: yellowed paper, dense old serif type with long-s letterforms as illegible text, soft vignette, filling the frame at a slight angle.

looks.label: Cut-out portraits and pie charts
looks.when: the thought experiment with photo cut-outs of real people and cats - never generated.

looks.label: News clip of a public figure
looks.when: a named politician or pundit - real footage only, never generated.

looks.label: Archival or broadcast footage
looks.when: real events - old newsreel, a TV broadcast, a floor vote, a strike at night - real footage only, never generated.

looks.label: Creator at the desk
looks.when: the creator on camera - never generated.
